name: Zest v2

priceBasis.protocol: Pyth Lazer feeds 1 (BTC) / 45 (STX) / 7 (USDC) verified inside each tx, max age 120 s; DIA USDh/USD; stSTX and stBTC ratios; vault liquidity indices
priceBasis.monitor: 7-venue CEX median for BTC/STX/USDC; on-chain DIA, LST ratios and indices read at the block

bandSource: BTC 0.60% and STX 1.05%: max Lazer-vs-reference deviation at block time in successful priced txs (measured from 1,583 decoded Lazer-carrying txs, 2026-08-13..09-22). USDC 0.25%: estimate [E], not yet measured.

candidates.meaning: next market implementation; Zest v2 switches have followed the deploy by 4-35 min

prices.method: median of last traded 1m candle close (<=300 s old) before block time; USDT quotes x median USDT/USD (kraken, coinbase)
